title: [finding] A list page (type: list, InterfacePageConfigSchema) declares no emptyState, and objectui's InterfaceListPage passes on only a source view's, so a page-level list cannot say what belongs there
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2793). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The maintainer accepted, for the cloud console's empty pages, "one plain sentence and one action" (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 6 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2776). Cloud's 「我的软件包」 / My Packages page is a `type: 'list'` page (`packages/service-tenant/src/pages/sys-package.page.ts`, `sys_package_mine`, filtered to `publisher = 'private'`). A list page has no key for its empty state, so the page cannot say "packages you publish appear here", even as text.

## Evidence

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:575-646` at cloud's pin `56bf27affb` (`InterfacePageConfigSchema`): no `emptyState`. `page.zod.ts` on `main` `6a7eca68` still has no `emptyState`.
- objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:503` (unchanged on objectui `main` `54159d3`): `emptyState: view.emptyState`. Only a resolved source view's empty state is passed on; the page itself has nothing to pass.
- The page's gallery visualization also ignores any authored empty state: objectstack-ai/objectui's `ObjectGallery.tsx:653` is filed separately as the renderer half (an objectui finding filed beside this one).

## What the consumer needs

An optional `emptyState` on the list page's interface config, with the same shape as the view's `EmptyStateSchema` (and the same action key, if the sibling finding on `EmptyStateSchema` is taken). objectui then draws it on every visualization, the gallery included. A seam in the usual order: spec first, then objectui.

## Delivery note

Cloud's framework pin is held at `56bf27affb` until the v18 move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so a fix reaches cloud with that move.

Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for `emptyState`, `interfaceConfig` empty state and `InterfacePageConfigSchema`: no match.
